messages:
incident-bot: [P1] Canary health fail -> eu-west-1 inference-api (/v1/generate). Healthcheck fail rate 7% > abort threshold 5%. Rollout: feature_fastpath v2 -> 10% traffic. Commit: 4f3b2a. Pager triggered.

alex: acknowledged, paging @jamal and @mira. I'm standing up a quick mitigation plan.

jamal: on it, looking at logs + prod metrics. can you paste the canary pod names?

alex: pods: inference-eu-canary-0, inference-eu-canary-1, inference-eu-canary-2. tailing logs now.

alex: ```
[2025-11-02T18:12:03Z] ERROR inference-eu-canary-1: 502 upstream model-run OOM - kv cache allocation failed
[2025-11-02T18:12:04Z] WARN  inference-eu-canary-0: healthcheck timeout (500ms)
[2025-11-02T18:12:10Z] ERROR inference-eu-canary-2: 503 model subprocess crash
```

mira: sounds like kv-cache or quantized path regressions. we have a kill-switch for feature_fastpath. I can flip it in console.

ben: caution - flipping fastpath will route to non-quant variant, expect token cost + latency bump. prefer kill-switch + scale up fallback variant first if possible.

deploy-bot: Rollout metadata: commit=4f3b2a, started=30m ago, target=10%, canary_hosts=12, healthcheck_fail_rate=7%, avg_latency +40ms over baseline.

jamal: trying quick mitigation: increasing replicas of fallback pool and removing canary weight. running: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-eu-fallback --replicas=6` and preparing flag flip.

alex: mira, please flip flag when jamal confirms fallback scaled.

mira: confirmed fallback scaled. flipping feature_fastpath -> false now.

mira: flipped :white_check_mark: feature_fastpath=false. triggering traffic reallocation to baseline.

alex: traffic reallocated, canary weight set to 0%.

incident-bot: UPDATE: Abort criteria met. Canary rollout halted. Healthcheck fail rate dropping to 1.2% (eu-west-1). No global rollback required.

jamal: confirming tail logs show fewer OOMs. running longer tail for 10m. so far no customer-facing surge in 5xx outside eu-west.

ben: good. next steps: create short postmortem (incidents channel) and hold on a deeper revert vs fix decision until RCA.

alex: handing off watcher to @tom for 2h. tom - you're oncall in 20m, please monitor dashboards and notify if error rate >2% or latency +100ms.

tom: thanks, I got it. will watch the dashboard and alert if things re-escalate. link: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/canary/4f3b2a

jamal: will follow up with a quick RCA draft and log excerpts in incidents. thanks all :thumbsup:

mira: adding note to rollout: avoid quantized-kv path until we validate memory profile.

alex: closing-thread for now, will update if anything else pops.
